import React from 'react'; import styles from './obraform.module.css'; import PropTypes from 'prop-types'; export default function ObraForm({formData, setFormData, onSubmit, editMode=false}){ const handleChange = (e) => { const { name, value } = e.target; setFormData(prev => ({...prev, [name]: value})); }; return (
); } ObraForm.propTypes = { formData: PropTypes.object.isRequired, setFormData: PropTypes.func.isRequired, onSubmit: PropTypes.func.isRequired, editMode: PropTypes.bool, };
